clarity.notes: Host now has a clear tournament flow: enter the team roster, start pairings, run the current match, then record the winner and advance to the next pair.

hierarchy.notes: Current match remains dominant, while the dashboard adds leaderboard, match note, and history without crowding the problem or timer.

typography.notes: Projector-facing text remains large, while mobile team entry preserves big answer fields, compact status, and touch-sized controls.

motion.notes: Tournament state, current pair, and leaderboard sync through the same room state so Host, Scoreboard, and team devices stay aligned.

brand.notes: The battle arena and classroom game-show direction stays consistent across the online room flow and the single-machine backup.
